units.literal: On renyin the Wei Emperor issued an edict that Duke of Taiyuan Yang administer military and state affairs, and sent a palace envoy to urge him earnestly.

units.zh: 時太原公洋在城東雙堂，入而討賊，臠割京等，皆漆其頭。
units.en: At the time Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.
units.literal: At the time Prince of Taiyuan Gao Yang was at the Twin Hall east of the city; he entered and punished the traitors, dismembering Jing and the rest and lacquering their heads.

units.zh: 及侯景西上，鐵虎從僧辯克任約，獲宋子仙，每戰皆有功。
units.en: When Hou Jing marched west, Tiehu followed Sengbian against Ren Yue, took Song Zixian prisoner, and earned merit in every fight.
units.literal: When Hou Jing marched west, Tiehu followed Sengbian in defeating Ren Yue, captured Song Zixian, and in every battle had merit.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 車騎將軍、開府儀同三司侯瑱進位司空，中權將軍、開府儀同三司、新除左光祿大夫王沖為太子少傅。
units.en: Hou Tian, grand general of chariots and cavalry and grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, was promoted to minister of works; Wang Chong, central authority general, grand mentor with staff equal to the three dukes, and newly appointed left grand master of the palace, became junior tutor of the crown prince.
units.literal: Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes Hou Tian advanced in rank to Minister of Works; Central Authority General, Grand Mentor with the Staff Equal to the Three Dukes, and newly appointed Left Grand Master of the Palace Wang Chong became Junior Tutor of the Crown Prince.

units.zh: [12]辛卯，詔車騎將軍、司空侯瑱總督水步眾軍以遏齊寇。
units.en: [12] On xinmao day an edict placed Hou Tian, grand general of chariots and cavalry and minister of works, in overall command of naval and land forces to block the Qi invasion.
units.literal: [12] On xinmao day an edict ordered Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and Minister of Works Hou Tian to take overall command of the water and land combined armies to check the Qi invaders.

units.zh: 二年春正月乙未，詔曰：「夫設官分職，因事重輕，羽儀車馬，隨時隆替，晉之五校，鳴笳啟途，漢之九卿，傳呼並迾，虞官夏禮，豈曰同科，殷朴周文，固無恆格。
units.en: In spring of the second year, on yiwei day of the first month, an edict declared: "Offices and duties are weighed by the business at hand; ceremonial escorts rise and fall with the age. Jin's Five Commandants sounded the reed-pipe to clear the road; Han's nine ministers had heralds cry out as they passed—Yu and Xia rites were not one model; Yin austerity and Zhou ornament had no fixed pattern.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, on yiwei day, an edict said: "Setting offices and dividing duties follows the weight of affairs; feathered banners and chariots and horses rise and fall with the times. Jin's Five Commandants sounded the reed-whistle to open the road; Han's Nine Ministers had runners call out together as they passed—rites of Yu and Xia, how could they be one standard? Yin simplicity and Zhou pattern surely have no fixed rule.

units.zh: 荊、雍之界，蠻左數反，山帥文道期積為邊患，中兵王僧辯征之，頻戰不利，遣量助之。
units.en: On the Jing–Yong frontier the southern tribes rose again and again. The mountain chief Wen Daoqi had long plagued the border. Wang Sengbian campaigned against him without success and sent Liang to help.
units.literal: On the border between Jing and Yong, the southern barbarians repeatedly rebelled; the mountain chief Wen Daoqi had long been a frontier trouble; middle-arms Wang Sengbian campaigned against him but repeatedly fought without success and sent Liang to assist.

units.zh: 量至，與僧辯并力，大破道期，斬其酋長，俘虜萬計。
units.en: When Liang arrived he and Sengbian joined forces, crushed Daoqi, beheaded the chiefs, and took tens of thousands of captives.
units.literal: When Liang arrived, he and Sengbian joined forces, inflicted a great defeat on Daoqi, beheaded the chieftains, and took captives numbering in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 列傳第十五 臧燾徐廣傅隆
units.en: Biography 15 — Zang Dao, Xu Guang, and Fu Long
units.literal: Biography 15: Zang Dao, Xu Guang, Fu Long

units.zh: 時太廟鴟尾災，燾謂著作郎徐廣曰：「昔孔子在齊，聞魯廟災，曰必桓、僖也。
units.en: When fire broke out at the finials of the Imperial Ancestral Temple, Dao said to Xu Guang of the Master of Writings office: "Long ago, when Confucius was in Qi and heard that Lu's ancestral temple had burned, he said the disaster must concern the shrines of Duke Huan and Duke Xi.
units.literal: At that time the temple finials of the Imperial Ancestral Temple caught fire; Dao said to Xu Guang, Master of Writings: "Formerly when Confucius was in Qi and heard of fire in the Lu temple, he said it must concern Huan and Xi.

units.zh: 徐廣，字野民，東莞姑幕人也。
units.en: Xu Guang, whose courtesy name was Yemin, came from Gumu in Dongguan.
units.literal: Xu Guang, styled Yemin, was a native of Gumu in Dongguan.

units.zh: 臣等參詳，宜敕著作郎徐廣撰成國史。」
units.en: We your subjects have reviewed the matter and submit that Xu Guang of the Master of Writings office should be ordered to complete the national history."
units.literal: We your subjects have examined the matter and hold that Xu Guang, Master of Writings, should be ordered to complete the national history."

units.zh: 臧燾、徐廣、傅隆、裴松之、何承天、雷次宗，並服膺聖哲，不為雅俗推移，立名於世，宜矣。
units.en: Zang Dao, Xu Guang, Fu Long, Pei Songzhi, He Chengtian, and Lei Cizong all devoted themselves to the sages, were not swayed by fashion, and won renown in their age — as was only fitting.
units.literal: Zang Dao, Xu Guang, Fu Long, Pei Songzhi, He Chengtian, and Lei Cizong all embraced the sage and wise in their hearts, were not shifted by elegant fashion or vulgar custom, and established names in the world — as was fitting.

units.zh: 永初元年，詔曰：「祕書監徐廣，學優行謹，歷位恭肅，可中散大夫。」
units.en: In the first year of Yongchu, an edict said: "Director of the Secretariat Xu Guang is superior in learning and careful in conduct, and in successive offices has been reverent and dignified; he may be appointed Grand Master of Leisure."
units.literal: In the first year of Yongchu, an edict said: "Director of the Secretariat Xu Guang is superior in learning and careful in conduct, and in successive offices has been reverent and dignified; he may be appointed Grand Master of Leisure."

units.zh: 謝晦見之，謂之曰：「徐公將無小過？」
units.en: Xie Hui saw this and said to him: "Master Xu, are you not going a little too far?"
units.literal: Xie Hui saw this and said to him: "Master Xu, are you not being a little excessive?"

units.zh: 十二年，《晉紀》成，凡四十六卷，表上之。
units.en: In the twelfth year he completed the Annals of Jin in forty-six volumes and submitted them to the throne.
units.literal: In the twelfth year the Annals of Jin were completed, forty-six volumes in all, and were submitted in memorial.

units.zh: 家世好學，至廣尤精，百家數術，無不研覽。
units.en: His family had long valued learning, and Guang surpassed them all, studying every branch of the hundred schools and the arts of calculation without exception.
units.literal: His family for generations loved learning; Guang was especially accomplished, and among the hundred schools and numerological arts there was none he did not study.

units.zh: 晉孝武帝以廣博學，除為秘書郎，校書秘閣，增置職僚。
units.en: Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, recognizing Guang's erudition, appointed him Secretary Gentleman to collate books in the Secret Archive and expanded the staff.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, because Guang was broadly learned, appointed him Secretary Gentleman to collate books in the Secret Archive and added staff positions.

units.zh: 遷秘書監。
units.en: He was appointed Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 父藻，都水使者。
units.en: His father Zao served as Commissioner of Waterways.
units.literal: His father Zao was Commissioner of Waterways.

units.zh: 息道玄謬荷朝恩，忝宰此邑，乞相隨之官，歸終桑梓，微志獲申，殞沒無恨。」
units.en: My son Daoxuan has undeservedly received the court's grace and shamefully serves as magistrate of this district; I beg to follow him to his post, return to end my days in my native place, fulfill my humble wish, and die without regret."
units.literal: My son Daoxuan has undeservedly received the court's grace and shamefully serves as magistrate of this district; I beg to follow him to his post, return to end my days in my native place, fulfill my humble wish, and die without regret."

units.zh: 元嘉二年，卒，時年七十四。
units.en: In the second year of Yuanjia he died, at the age of seventy-four.
units.literal: In the second year of Yuanjia he died, at the age of seventy-four.

units.zh: 隆安中，尚書令王珣舉為祠部郎。
units.en: During the Longan era, Minister of Works Wang Xun recommended him as Director of the Sacrifices Bureau.
units.literal: In the Longan era, Minister of Works Wang Xun recommended him as Director of the Sacrifices Bureau.

units.zh: 義熙初，高祖使撰車服儀注，乃除鎮軍諮議參軍，領記室。
units.en: At the beginning of Yixi the Founding Emperor commissioned him to compile regulations for carriages, robes, and ceremonial protocol, and appointed him advisory aide on the Army Who Guards the Army staff, with charge of the secretariat.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yixi the Founding Emperor had him compile regulations for carriages, robes, and ceremonial observances, and appointed him advisory aide of the Army Who Guards the Army, heading the secretariat.

units.zh: 轉員外散騎常侍，領著作郎。
units.en: He was promoted to Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and appointed head of the Master of Writings office.
units.literal: He was transferred to Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and headed the office of Master of Writings.

units.zh: 封樂成縣五等侯。
units.en: He was enfeoffed as fifth-rank Marquis of Lecheng county.
units.literal: He was enfeoffed as fifth-rank Marquis of Lecheng county.

units.zh: 李太后薨，廣議服曰：「太皇太后名位允正，體同皇極，理制備盡，情禮彌申。
units.en: When Empress Dowager Li died, Guang offered a ritual opinion on mourning dress, saying: "The grand empress dowager's title and rank are fully legitimate, her status equals the imperial apex, the ritual logic is complete, and the emotional obligation is all the greater.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Li died, Guang offered a ritual opinion on mourning dress, saying: "The grand empress dowager's title and station are fully orthodox, her status equals the imperial pole, reason and regulation are complete, and feeling and ritual are all the more extended.

units.zh: 陽秋之義，母以子貴，既稱夫人，禮服從正，故成風顯夫人之號，文公服三年之喪。
units.en: The Spring and Autumn principle is that a mother is honored through her son; once she bears the title of consort, ritual mourning follows the standard form. Thus Cheng Feng received the title of lady, and Duke Wen wore three years of mourning.
units.literal: The meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that the mother is ennobled through the son; once she is styled lady, ritual garments follow the orthodox rule. Thus Cheng Feng displayed the title of lady, and Duke Wen wore three years of mourning.

units.zh: 子於父之所生，體尊義重。
units.en: A child owes deep obligation to the mother his father honored.
units.literal: A child toward what the father bore is honored in status and heavy in obligation.

units.zh: 且禮祖不厭孫，固宜遂服無屈。
units.en: Moreover, ritual holds that an ancestor does not reject a grandson; mourning should be worn in full, without reduction.
units.literal: Moreover, in ritual the ancestor does not weary of the grandson; mourning should therefore be worn without reduction.

units.zh: 而緣情立制，若嫌明文不存，則疑斯從重。
units.en: When regulation is shaped by affection, and no explicit text survives, the safer course is the heavier mourning.
units.literal: Yet when establishing regulations by feeling, if one doubts because no explicit text survives, then one should follow the heavier mourning.

units.zh: 謂應同於為祖母後，齊衰三年。」
units.en: He held that the emperor should follow the same rule as for a paternal grandmother—three years of qi mourning."
units.literal: He held that one should follow the same rule as for a paternal grandmother—three years of qi-sackcloth mourning."

units.zh: 時有風雹為災，廣獻書高祖曰：「風雹變未必為災，古之聖賢輒懼而修己，所以興政化而隆德教也。
units.en: When wind and hail brought disaster, Guang wrote to the Founding Emperor: "Such omens are not necessarily calamities; the sages of antiquity always took them as warnings to refine themselves — and thereby raised good government and exalted moral teaching.
units.literal: At the time wind and hail caused disaster; Guang submitted a letter to the Founding Emperor: "Wind and hail changes are not necessarily calamities; the sages of antiquity always feared them and cultivated themselves — thereby they raised government and exalted moral teaching.

units.zh: 嘗忝服事，宿眷未忘，思竭塵露，率誠于習。
units.en: I once had the honor to serve you and have not forgotten your kindness; I wish to offer whatever humble strength remains and speak with all sincerity from my experience.
units.literal: I once had the honor to serve you and have not forgotten your longstanding favor; I wish to exhaust the dust and dew of my strength and offer sincerity in what I have learned.

units.zh: 明公初建義旗，匡複宗社，神武應運，信宿平夷。
units.en: When you first raised the righteous banner and restored the ancestral altars, your divine martial prowess answered Heaven's mandate, and peace was restored within days.
units.literal: When you first raised the righteous banner, restored the ancestral altars, and with divine martial prowess answered Heaven's mandate, peace was restored within a day or two.

units.zh: 且恭儉謙約，虛心匪懈，來蘇之化，功用若神。
units.en: Moreover you are respectful, frugal, and modest, never slack in self-cultivation; the relief you bring to the people works as if by divine power.
units.literal: Moreover you are respectful, frugal, modest, and restrained, humble in mind and never slack; the transformation of those who awaken from suffering works with godlike effect.

units.zh: 頃事故既多，刑德並用，戰功殷積，報敘難盡，萬機繁湊，固應難速，且小細煩密，群下多懼。
units.en: Recently affairs have multiplied, punishment and reward are applied together, military merit has piled up and rewards are hard to dispense, and the myriad tasks are pressing — swift action is naturally difficult; moreover petty matters are intricate and many subordinates live in fear.
units.literal: Recently affairs have multiplied, punishment and virtue are applied together, military merit has heaped up and rewards are hard to exhaust, and the myriad tasks are dense and pressing — naturally speed is difficult; moreover petty matters are intricate and many below are fearful.

units.zh: 又谷帛豐賤，而民情不勸；
units.en: Grain and cloth are abundant and cheap, yet the people are not encouraged to prosper;
units.literal: Again, grain and cloth are abundant and cheap, yet the people's hearts are not encouraged;

units.zh: 禁司互設，而劫盜多有，誠由俗弊未易整，而望深未易炳。
units.en: prohibitory offices multiply upon one another, yet robbery remains common — truly because popular abuses are hard to correct and deep expectations are hard to satisfy at once.
units.literal: prohibitory offices are set up in mutual overlap, yet banditry is frequent — truly because popular abuses are not easily rectified and expectations run deep and are not easily made clear.

units.zh: 追思義熙之始，如有不同，何者？
units.en: Looking back to the beginning of Yixi, if something has changed, what is it?
units.literal: Reflecting on the beginning of Yixi, if there is something different, what is it?

units.zh: 好安願逸，萬物之大趣，習舊駭新，凡識所不免。
units.en: The love of ease is the great tendency of all things, and alarm at the new when accustomed to the old is what ordinary minds cannot avoid.
units.literal: Loving rest and wishing for ease is the great tendency of all things; being startled by the old when facing the new is what ordinary understanding cannot avoid.

units.zh: 要當俯順群情，抑揚隨俗，則朝野歡泰，具瞻允康矣。
units.en: What matters is to heed the feelings of the people and adjust policy to custom — then court and countryside will rejoice in peace, and all who look to you will find true well-being.
units.literal: The essential thing is to bow to the feelings of the multitude and moderate and elevate according to custom — then court and countryside will rejoice in peace, and all who look up will find true tranquility.

units.zh: 言無可采，願矜其愚款之志。」
units.en: My words may have little worth; I only ask that you regard the sincerity of my humble counsel."
units.literal: My words have nothing worth adopting; I only ask that you regard the sincerity of my foolish loyalty."

units.zh: 廣收淚答曰：「身與君不同。
units.en: Guang wiped away his tears and replied: "My situation and yours are not the same.
units.literal: Guang wiped away his tears and replied: "My person and yours are not the same.

units.zh: 君佐命興王，逢千載嘉運；
units.en: You assisted the mandate and helped raise the new dynasty, meeting a once-in-a-millennium fortune;
units.literal: You assisted the mandate and raised the royal house, meeting a thousand-year auspicious fortune;

units.zh: 身世荷晉德，實眷戀故主。」
units.en: my family and I received Jin's grace and truly remain attached to the former sovereign."
units.literal: my person and family received Jin's grace and truly cherish attachment to the former lord."

units.zh: 初，桓玄篡位，安帝出宮，廣陪列悲慟，哀動左右。
units.en: Earlier, when Huan Xuan usurped the throne and Emperor An was driven from the palace, Guang stood in attendance weeping so bitterly that he moved all those around him.
units.literal: Earlier, when Huan Xuan usurped the throne and Emperor An left the palace, Guang stood in attendance, grieved and sobbed, moving those on either side.

units.zh: 及高祖受禪，恭帝遜位，廣又哀感，涕泗交流。
units.en: When the Founding Emperor accepted the abdication and Emperor Gong yielded the throne, Guang was again overcome with grief, tears streaming down his face.
units.literal: When the Founding Emperor received the abdication and Emperor Gong yielded the throne, Guang again was moved to grief, tears and mucus streaming down.

units.zh: 臣墳墓在晉陵，臣又生長京口，戀舊懷遠，每感暮心。
units.en: My ancestral graves are at Jinling, and I also grew up at Jingkou; cherishing the old and longing for the distant, I am moved each evening in my heart.
units.literal: My ancestral graves are at Jinling, and I also grew up at Jingkou; cherishing the old and longing for the distant, I am moved each evening in my heart.

units.zh: 性好讀書，老猶不倦。
units.en: By nature he loved reading and even in old age was not weary of it.
units.literal: By nature he loved reading and even in old age was not weary of it.

units.zh: 謝玄為州，辟廣從事西曹。
units.en: When Xie Xuan served as regional inspector, he recruited Guang as an aide in the Western Bureau.
units.literal: When Xie Xuan was regional inspector, he summoned Guang as Western Bureau aide.

units.zh: 時會稽王世子元顯錄尚書，欲使百僚致敬，台內使廣立議，由是內外並執下官禮，廣常為愧恨焉。
units.en: At the time Yuanxian, heir of the Prince of Kuaiji, controlled the Secretariat and wished all officials to pay him homage; Guang was ordered to draft the proposal within the capital, and thereafter officials inside and outside the court observed subordinate rites toward him — a matter that often filled Guang with shame and regret.
units.literal: At the time the heir of the Prince of Kuaiji, Yuanxian, controlled the Secretariat and wished all officials to pay him homage; within the capital Guang was made to draft the proposal, and thereafter inside and outside alike observed the rites of subordinate officers — Guang often felt shame and resentment over this.

units.zh: 桓玄輔政，以為大將軍文學祭酒。
units.en: When Huan Xuan served as regent, he appointed Guang libationer of letters on the Grand Marshal's staff.
units.literal: When Huan Xuan held power as regent, he appointed Guang libationer of letters on the Grand Marshal's staff.

units.zh: 廣上表曰：「臣年時衰耄，朝敬永闕，端居都邑，徒增替怠。
units.en: Guang submitted a memorial saying: "I am now aged and decrepit and can no longer attend court in reverence; dwelling idly in the capital only adds to my remorse and slackness.
units.literal: Guang submitted a memorial saying: "I am now aged and decrepit and can no longer attend court in reverence; dwelling idly in the capital only adds to my remorse and slackness.

units.zh: 廣兄子豁，在良吏傳。
units.en: Guang's elder brother's son Huo is treated in the Biographies of Worthy Officials.
units.literal: Guang's elder brother's son Huo is treated in the Biographies of Worthy Officials.
